items.title: Circuit Breaker Labs hopes to make AI safer for your kids (and you)
items.summary: With all the talk about how AI might one day ill us all, it's easy to forget that AI has already harmed some people, psychologically. Circuit Breaker Labs has created "crash test dummies" to solve that.

items.title: Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery to become Skydance
items.summary: The roughly $110 billion deal is expected to close October 6.

items.title: Pope Leo XIV is not a fan of AI-generated art
items.summary: "There is an ontological difference, even before an aesthetic one, between art and what a machine can generate through statistical calculation based on millions of images created by others," the pope wrote. "Algorithms lack the spark of humanity."

items.title: Laytr’s new app lets you save anything you find online, not just articles to read
items.summary: Laytr lets you save articles, recipes, screenshots, videos, PDFs, and more for later, while keeping your archive private and synced across your Apple devices.

items.title: Tesla sustains its EV sales momentum despite US troubles
items.summary: The company delivered more than 486,000 EVs in the third quarter, down from last year's record but moving in a positive direction.

items.title: Medical records giant Epic pauses product development to fix security bugs that risk patients’ data
items.summary: The health tech software giant, which makes the widely used MyChart system for accessing medical data, will focus on fixing security bugs for the next few weeks.

items.title: Rivian’s R2 just helped it set a new sales record
items.summary: Deliveries jumped roughly 45% compared to the same quarter last year, with Rivian delivering more than 19,000 EVs.

items.title: Rivian issues R2 recall for poorly tightened battery packs
items.summary: The company says around 14 vehicles may be affected, and that it has resolved the issue on the assembly line.

items.title: Robotaxi operators will face fines for blocking first responders
items.summary: A new California law places new rules on autonomous vehicles operators.

items.title: The founder’s guide to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Everything you need to know
items.summary: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 is built around one question: How do you build an enduring company in the AI era? Our programming and speaker lineup reflect that.

items.title: Lyft is paying $272.5M to settle lawsuit over how it classified drivers
items.summary: Today, gig economy drivers are classified as contractors. This settlement clears up a lingering lawsuit from 2020 when that was still an unanswered issue.

items.title: Kevin Mandia’s new ‘agent swarm’ security startup Armadin raises $255.5M at $2.5B valuation
items.summary: Kevin Mandia, best known as the founder of Mandiant, has a new startup that is using agent swarms to test and protect enterprises.

items.title: Musk’s AI chatbot Grok reportedly encouraged Trump to capture Venezuela’s president
items.summary: President Trump reportedly asked for Grok's opinion before invading Venezuela and capturing Nicolás Maduro.

items.title: ChatGPT can now virtually try on clothes for you
items.summary: OpenAI is rolling out new shopping features for ChatGPT that let users virtually try on clothing and accessories using their own photos and save products they like to a Favorites library.

items.title: Google thinks SpaceX’s Starship has to launch 1,800 times before space data centers get off the ground
items.summary: Google launched its first advanced chip into orbit to pave the way for space data centers.
